# Godot PCK Explorer Third Party Notices

This directory contains the Godot PCK Explorer dotnet UI/console distribution
and its native `mbedTLS_AES` libraries.

- License: MIT

## mbedTLS_AES / Mbed TLS

- Files: `mbedTLS/**/*`
- Upstream: https://github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls
- License notice: Mbed TLS files are generally provided under a dual
  Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later license unless specifically indicated
  otherwise by upstream files.
- Local Apache-2.0 text: `mbedTLS/LICENSE_APACHE-2.0.txt`

The native `mbedTLS_AES` files are distributed together with Godot PCK Explorer
so encrypted Godot PCK operations can run.
